newsitem.title: USA: Muni bond yields mixed over past week -- Delphis.
newsitem.headline: Muni bond yields mixed over past week -- Delphis.

text.p: Municipal bond yields were mixed in the week ended Thursday, Delphis Hanover Corp said Friday.
Thirty-year, Aaa-rated municipal yields fell five basis points to 5.45 percent. Thirty-year Baa yields were unchanged at 6.25 percent.
High-grade munis outperformed Treasuries over the period, as the government long bond rose two basis points by the close Thursday to 6.65 percent from 6.63 percent.
Thirty-year, Aaa-rated munis were yielding 82 percent of the Treasury long bond at the close Thursday.
Average yields on one-year municipal bonds were unchanged across the credit spectrum, holding at 3.55 percent in the Aaa category and 4.35 percent for Baa's.
In the intermediate sector, ten-year Aaa-rated municipal bonds were unchanged at 4.70 percent, and Baa-rated ten-years rose five to 5.60 percent.
The triple-A yield curve between one-year and 30-year munis flattened five basis points to 190 basis points. The Baa curve was unchanged from last week at 190 basis points.
The credit spread between Aaa-rated and Baa-rated one-years was unchanged at 80 basis points. The 30-year spread was five wider, at 80 basis points.
